purpose: Post-encounter persistence plus linear non-axisymmetric response under the unchanged Candidate 1 scalar action
preflight: Implementation controls and one time-2 isolated-object timing pilot ran before this freeze; no extended encounter outcome observed.

measurement_conventions.mode_norm: Angular-integrated positive canonical norm: integral(delta fields squared + delta momenta squared), cos(m phi) angular factor 1/2 for m>0; no claim this norm is unique or conserved.
measurement_conventions.initial_normalization: Each mode starts at 1e-4 of the same norm of background (with S-1).
measurement_conventions.linear_warning: First background-relative norm >=0.1 flags loss of a quantitative finite-amplitude linear approximation. This is not a numerical-failure condition or a nonlinear evolved state.
measurement_conventions.object_diagnostics: Axial F^2 regions above 5% maximum and at least 5% total norm; centers define radius 8/12/16 balls. Overlapping balls flagged. Region count and local E/Q are diagnostics, not exact particle certification.
measurement_conventions.boundaries: Vacuum ghosts, enlarged to postpone radiation returns; compare larger boxes over the same window. No physical damping or particle removal.

limitations: Only selected m=1 and m=2 perturbations, no nonlinear 3D evolution
No inference of exponential chaos or all-mode stability from positive-norm growth
No formation, memory apparatus, quantum or gravity result
